items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: He was with Al Stringer band, had the pleasure of working with him four or five years with the Al Stringer band.

ctx.x: I, I, I, I'm curious whether they added a, well you know they called them boy singers and girl singers in. Would they add any boy singers? Well they call them vocalists, so.

Yeah. They're vocalists, I guess. Now, Irving Dusan who was presently president of Columbia Homestead, gave up playing trumpet, he's president of Homestead. He has a brother who is an attorney, Edward Dusan. Now he played fine trumpet also. He was with Al Stringer band, had the pleasure of working with him four or five years with the Al Stringer band. He's doing very little playing now. I doubt if he's playing at all, because he's a very busy attorney nowadays. All those fellas, I understand at one time, I don't…
It could be before you joined.
